title: Vox & MENS Comparative Efficacy Benchmarking: Research, Gap Audit, and Automation Plan (2026)
summary: Research on HLE/benchmarking practices, code-audited gap map of SCIENTIA and model router vs market, and plan for live contamination-resistant voxlang.org leaderboard.
notes: Research document combining HLE lessons (A), publishing rules audit (B), metrics inventory (C), and code-audited gap maps of SCIENTIA (D) and model router (E). Sections F-G propose concrete architectures and automation plans. Marked training_eligible:false to avoid contaminating held-out benchmark fixtures (§H). Produces research findings and recommendations, not binding specifications.
